name: BE-EMMA Score
description: Background/Introduction Middle meningeal artery embolization (MMAE) is an effective treatment for chronic subdural hematoma (cSDH). However, angiographic assessment remains heterogeneous and non-standardized, limiting comparability across studies. While existing grading systems have contributed to structured assessment, they are mostly technique-specific and do not yet provide a unified anatomy-based framework. Objective/Purpose To develop and validate the BE-EMMA Score, a reproducible angiographic scoring framework applicable across embolic techniques for standardized evaluation of MMAE. Methods/Case Description The BE-EMMA Score was developed through structured literature review and iterative expert consensus involving four neurointerventionalists. It comprises a Main Score capturing branch dominance and branch-specific embolization extent, complemented by optional modifiers for anatomical and procedural constraints. Validation was performed by retrospectively applying the score to MMAE procedures for cSDH at three tertiary hospital sites within a single academic center (01/2023–09/2024). Two blinded neurointerventionalists independently scored all cases. Inter-rater reliability was assessed using Cohen‘s κ and percentage agreement. Results/Findings Results Fifty MMAE procedures in 36 patients were evaluated.
